Question: Can you chart new paid sign-ups by month for the first half of the year?

Tallyflow's new paid sign-ups for January through June are shown below [1][2].

```mermaid
xychart-beta
    title "New paid sign-ups, H1"
    x-axis [Jan, Feb, Mar, Apr, May, Jun]
    y-axis "Sign-ups" 0 --> 250
    bar [96, 110, 121, 142, 168, 205]
```

Sign-ups rose every month, more than doubling from 96 in January to 205 in June [1][2]. The biggest jump came in June after the free trial extension launched [1].
